simple.meaning: גֶּחֶל (gechel) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an ember.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Leviticus 16:12. The surrounding context includes family, altar, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֶּחֶל (H1513) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: גֶּחֶל (gechel) / H1513 is traced through Leviticus 16:12, 2 Samuel 14:7, 2 Samuel 22:9, 2 Samuel 22:13 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

majorEvents.label: Death
majorEvents.evidenceText: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.”

timeline.evidenceText: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”
Smoke went up out of his nostrils.
Who can strip off his outer garment?
He bowed the heavens also, and came down.
Yahweh also thundered in the sky.
He sent out his arrows, and scattered them;
An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth.
Or can one walk on hot coals,
for you will heap coals of fire on his head,
As coals are to hot embers,

As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.”
Then set it empty on its coals,

definitions.full: H1513. gechel or gacheleth גַּחֶ֫לֶת noun feminine Exod 1:13 coal (compare Assyrian gu—lu, a shining precious stone? COT Gloss Zim BP 45 ) — absolute גַּחֶלֶת Isa 47:14 ; suffix גַּחַלְתִּי 2Sam 14:7 ; plural גֶּחָלִים Psa 18:9 6 t.; construct גַּחֲלֵי Lev 16:12 5 t. + Psa 18:14 (strike out ᵐ5 De Che); suffix גֶּחָלָיו Isa 44:19 , גֶּחָלֶיהָ Ezek 24:11 ; — coal , plural ׳ג אֵשׁ coals of fire Lev 16:12 (P), 2Sam 22:13 = Psa 18:13 [also 18:14 compare above] Ezek 10:2 (in vision); compare 2Sam 22:9 = Psa 18:9 ; Job 41:13 , also Prov 6:28 ; Isa 44:19 ; in simile (of strife) Prov 26:21 (opposed to מֶּחָם black coal ); Ezek 1:13 אֵשׁ גַּחֲלֵי (of the living creatures); figurative of hope in posterity 2Sam 14:7 , of divine judgement, ׳ג רתם coals of broom-plant Psa 120:4 , compare 140:11 , also (negative) Isa 47:14 ; Ezek 24:11 ; of kindness to enemy Prov 25:22 . גחם (? compare Arabic kindle , , burn ).
definitions.rootNote: or (feminine) גַּחֶלֶת ; from an unused root meaning to glow or kindle ;
